newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P RATES WESTFIELD TRUST PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P RATES WESTFIELD TRUST PROGRAMME.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said it has assigned its A-plus corporate credit rating and its A-1 short-term rating to the A$600 million commerical paper programme issued by Westfield Trust.
The ratings reflect a strong market position, sustainable asset quality, some geographic diversity, and a high degree of operating stability, S&P said.
"Compared with historical levels, an increase in debt usage to fund ambitious asset growth will heighten Westfield's financial risk," the rating agency said.
S&P said that Westfield's rating outlook is stable and it is expected to maintain its strong market position while adopting a more aggressive prudential framework than previously.
Westfields's asset quality and operating stability will likely support the increase debt obligations at the current rating, S&P added.
